spec.description: Scheduled task states, results and missed runs of one Windows host.
Number of registered tasks that match the collector include and exclude filters. Requires the scheduled_task collector, which is not enabled by default.
spec.title: Tasks

spec.description: Tasks that are running now. Requires the scheduled_task collector, which is not enabled by default.
spec.title: Running

spec.description: Tasks that are disabled and do not run. Requires the scheduled_task collector, which is not enabled by default.
spec.title: Disabled

spec.expr: count(windows_scheduled_task_last_result_status{job=~"$job", instance="$instance", status="unknown"} == 1 and on (task) windows_scheduled_task_state{job=~"$job", instance="$instance", state!="disabled"} == 1) or (0 * count(windows_scheduled_task_state{job=~"$job", instance="$instance"}))

spec.description: Enabled tasks whose last result code has no named status. This is usually a non-zero exit code of the task or a Task Scheduler error, so check the task history. Requires the scheduled_task collector, which is not enabled by default.
spec.title: Unknown code

spec.expr: count(windows_scheduled_task_missed_runs{job=~"$job", instance="$instance"} > 0 and on (task) windows_scheduled_task_state{job=~"$job", instance="$instance", state!="disabled"} == 1) or (0 * count(windows_scheduled_task_state{job=~"$job", instance="$instance"}))

spec.description: Enabled tasks that missed at least one scheduled run, for example because the host was off or asleep. Requires the scheduled_task collector, which is not enabled by default.
spec.title: Missed runs

spec.description: Tasks that have not run since they were registered. Requires the scheduled_task collector, which is not enabled by default.
spec.title: Never run

spec.expr: max by (task) (windows_scheduled_task_last_result_status{job=~"$job", instance="$instance", status="unknown"} == 1 and on (task) windows_scheduled_task_state{job=~"$job", instance="$instance", state!="disabled"} == 1)

spec.description: Enabled tasks whose last result code has no named status, usually a non-zero exit code of the task or a Task Scheduler error. Requires the scheduled_task collector, which is not enabled by default.
spec.title: Tasks with an unknown result code

spec.expr: max by (task) (windows_scheduled_task_missed_runs{job=~"$job", instance="$instance"} > 0 and on (task) windows_scheduled_task_state{job=~"$job", instance="$instance", state!="disabled"} == 1)

spec.description: Enabled tasks that missed at least one scheduled run, with the number of missed runs reported by Task Scheduler. Requires the scheduled_task collector, which is not enabled by default.
spec.title: Tasks with missed runs

spec.expr: max by (task) (windows_scheduled_task_state{job=~"$job", instance="$instance", state="running"}) and on (task) (max_over_time(windows_scheduled_task_state{job=~"$job", instance="$instance", state="running"}[$__range] @ end()) == 1)

spec.description: Tasks that were running at a scrape in the selected time range. Runs shorter than the scrape interval can be missed. Requires the scheduled_task collector, which is not enabled by default.
spec.title: Task runs

spec.expr: max by (task, state, status) ((windows_scheduled_task_state{job=~"$job", instance="$instance"} == 1) * on (task) group_left (status) (windows_scheduled_task_last_result_status{job=~"$job", instance="$instance"} == 1))

spec.description: All tasks with their state, last result and missed runs. Tasks that never ran report no missed runs. Requires the scheduled_task collector, which is not enabled by default.
spec.title: Tasks
Windows Exporter / Scheduled tasks
